result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. I ran the region tests (`*Region*`) and they pass. I didn't add a test for the T-1 to T-5 example.

The change is in `DataStore.listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I copied the `ORDER BY CASE t.priority …` clause from the sales-rep query, so both lists now sort the same way. I also updated the method's Javadoc. Closed tickets and tickets of other regions are still excluded, since the filters are unchanged.

`RegionManagerService` is the only caller, so nothing else is affected.
